The Lab Manager will also oversee technical staff scheduling, performance evaluation, and attendance records, evaluate and select new instruments and equipment, validate new equipment, and establish and implement emergency and preventative maintenance procedures on equipment. The role involves coordinating personnel, equipment, and incoming work, enforcing established departmental policies and procedures, and ensuring compliance with all regulatory agencies. The Lab Manager will be responsible for analyzing, troubleshooting, and resolving day-to-day technical issues, and will provide backup support for histopathology laboratory work including light grossing, embedding, paraffin and frozen microtomy, routine staining, special stains, immunofluorescence, and electron microscopy. The Lab Manager will also own technical staff scheduling, performance evaluation, and attendance records, evaluate and select new instruments and equipment, validate new equipment, and establish and implement emergency and preventative maintenance procedures on equipment. Lead coordination of personnel, equipment, and incoming work. Will enforce established departmental policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with all regulatory agencies. Will be accountable for analyzing, troubleshooting, and resolving day-to-day technical issues. The Lab Manager will deliver back-up support for a busy histopathology laboratory including light grossing, embedding, paraffin & frozen microtomy, routine staining, special stains, immunofluorescence, and electron microscopy. The incumbent will execute and maintain QA/QC policies and procedures and maintain statistical records and other related laboratory duties.

25% - Own daily technical workflow & staff supervision, including technical staff scheduling, performance evaluation, and attendance records. Lead training of new hires and other supporting staff.
10% - Drive troubleshooting and resolution of routine technical issues. Maintain and manage laboratory equipment, which includes all types of equipment. Take the lead in setting up, evaluating, and troubleshooting new techniques.
5% - Execute and maintain QA/QC procedures as per policy and procedures. Maintain statistical records and other related records pertaining to the laboratory.
5% - Oversee lab's supply inventory.
5% - Perform other duties as assigned.

Coordinate personnel, equipment, and incoming work. Will enforce established departmental policies and procedures ensuring compliance with all regulatory agencies. Will be responsible for analyzing, troubleshooting and resolving day-to-day technical issues. The Lab Manager will provide back up support for busy histopathology laboratory including light grossing, embedding, paraffin & frozen microtomy, routine staining, special stains, immunofluorescence, and electron microscopy. The incumbent will successfully carry out and maintain QA/QC policies and procedures and maintain statistical records and other related laboratory duties.
cond_0516.responsibilities:
50% - Tissue processing, embedding, tissue sectioning (paraffin and frozen), staining (H&E, specials, IHC, IF) and cover slipping. EM electron microscopy ultra-thin sectioning and tissue preparation. Analyzes, resolves, and trouble-shoots day-to-day histology tasks as needed.
25% Daily technical workflow & staff supervision, including technical staff scheduling, performance evaluation and attendance records. Assists in the training of new hire and other supporting staff.
10% - Facilitates troubleshooting and resolution of routine technical issues. Effectively trouble-shoots and maintains laboratory equipment, which includes all types of equipment. Assists in setting up, evaluating, and trouble-shooting new techniques.
5% - Successfully carries out and maintains QA/QC procedures as per policy and procedures. Maintains statistical records and other related records pertaining to the laboratory.
5% Oversee lab's supply inventory.
5% - Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0516.requirements:
[Location masked] Department of Education Clinical Lab Technician/Technologist license
Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience, combined with around four years of related experience
Some prior experience in routine histology technique
Master's degree and around one year of experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience
Prior experience in a supervisory capacity (histology lab) is helpful but not required
Familiarity with routine and specialized histology skills
Exposure to EM electron microscopy ultra-thin sectioning
Ability to work in an organized manner in accordance with established regulations, policies, and procedures
Working knowledge of highly complex laboratory equipment and/or computer applications
Able to work independently and with limited supervision
Background in a particular area of research, with some theoretical understanding and practical experience

The Lab Manager will also oversee technical staff scheduling, performance evaluation and attendance records, evaluate and select new instruments and equipment, validate new equipment, establish and implement emergency and preventative maintenance procedures on equipment. Coordinate personnel, equipment, and incoming work. Will enforce established departmental policies and procedures ensuring compliance with all regulatory agencies. Will be responsible for analyzing, troubleshooting and resolving day-to-day technical issues. The Lab Manager will provide back up support for busy histopathology laboratory including light grossing, embedding, paraffin & frozen microtomy, routine staining, special stains, immunofluorescence, and electron microscopy. The incumbent will successfully carry out and maintain QA/QC policies and procedures and maintain statistical records and other related laboratory duties. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp histopathology techniques and the logic of laboratory workflows.
cond_0643.responsibilities:
50% - Tissue processing, embedding, tissue sectioning (paraffin and frozen), staining (H&E, specials, IHC, IF) and cover slipping. EM electron microscopy ultra-thin sectioning and tissue preparation. Analyzes, resolves, and trouble-shoots day-to-day histology tasks as needed.
25% Daily technical workflow & staff supervision, including technical staff scheduling, performance evaluation and attendance records. Assists in the training of new hire and other supporting staff.
10% - Facilitates troubleshooting and resolution of routine technical issues. Effectively trouble-shoots and maintains laboratory equipment, which includes all types of equipment. Assists in setting up, evaluating, and trouble-shooting new techniques.
5% - Successfully carries out and maintains QA/QC procedures as per policy and procedures. Maintains statistical records and other related records pertaining to the laboratory.
5% Oversee lab's supply inventory.
5% - Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0643.requirements:
[Location masked] Department of Education Clinical Lab Technician/Technologist license
Bachelor's degree or equivalent in education and four years of related experience
Must have prior experience in routine histology technique.
Master's degree and at least one year of experience
Prior experience in a supervisory capacity (histology lab) is highly preferred
Must have routine and specialized histology skills.
EM electron microscopy ultra-thin sectioning
Ability to work in an organized manner in accordance with established regulations, policies, and procedures.
Must have experience with highly complex laboratory equipment and/or computer applications.
Must be able to work independently and under limited supervision.
Must have specialized theoretical understanding and practical experience in a particular area of research.
